description: Returns the live status, remaining/used data, and expiration date for one eSIM you own, looked up by its ICCID. Read-only. Use this after a purchase to track an eSIM, or whenever a user asks "how much data is left" or "is my eSIM active". The ICCID is returned by purchase_esim/purchase_phone_plan and listed by list_orders. Requires a connected agent wallet (OAuth or ak_live_ key).

iccid.description: The ICCID (the eSIM's unique serial number) returned by purchase_esim, purchase_phone_plan, or list_orders

name: get_esim_status
